notes: «وذكر، آخر» introduces an unnamed second transmitter who narrates from Abu al-Aswad: a second route, not a variant (rule 4)
The first route ends at Amr b. al-Harith: the text names no teacher for him in this report
«- رضى الله عنها -» blessing left out

fixes.reason: K6I places Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman b. Nawfal between Amr and Urwa; the text writes no such name and gives Abu al-Aswad after the unnamed transmitter

evidence.quote: عن عمرو بن الحارث، وذكر، آخر عن أبي الأسود
محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل
